# What's New for v0.2.13. Delivered verbatim to App Store Connect (comment
# lines like this one are stripped). Clear this file after the release.

• Daccord no longer collects crash reports, analytics or telemetry of any
  kind, and the prompt asking to send them is gone.
• Text now follows your device's text size setting, so Larger Text and the
  accessibility sizes scale the whole app.
• Improved text contrast in the Light and Solarized themes, and increased
  the smallest text sizes for readability.
